items.title: Litige fiscal transfer pricing avec l'IRS (annees fiscales 2010-2025) : plaidoiries orales presentees devant la Cour d'appel du 11e circuit fin juin 2026, decision attendue sous 6 a 12 mois. Exposition potentielle desormais chiffree par la societe a environ 14 Md$ d'impot et interets cumules selon la methodologie retenue par le Tax Court ; 6,0 Md$ deja verses en depot de garantie (IRS Tax Litigation Deposit). Le management se dit confiant de l'emporter en appel.
items.source: 10-Q T2 2026 (SEC) + transcript earnings call 28/07/2026 (reponse John Murphy, CFO)

compliance.note: Il ne s'agit pas d'une allegation de fraude comptable mais d'un differend de methodologie de prix de transfert (repartition des profits entre filiales) - de nature recurrente dans l'industrie pour les multinationales de cette taille. Le passif reste NON provisionne au bilan au-dela du depot de garantie deja verse ; en cas de defaite en appel, l'impact potentiel (~14 Md$) serait tres significatif rapporte a la capitalisation. Traite comme risque idiosyncratique hors base centrale (aucun adjXXX ne l'integre). (Recherche du 2026-08-04)

dernierCall.guidanceProchainTrimestre: Pas de guidance trimestrielle chiffree (guidance annuelle uniquement). Elements qualitatifs T3 26 : expeditions de concentre en retard d'1 point sur les volumes unitaires (effet de timing).
dernierCall.guidanceAnnuelle: Organique ~5% (haut de la fourchette 4-5% precedente), comparable EPS all-in +9-10% vs 3,00$ en 2025 (releve de +8-9%), comparable EPS change constant hors M&A +7-8% (releve de +6-7%), ETR sous-jacent maintenu a 19,9%. Cession CCBA supposee cloturee fin T3/T4 26 (headwind 2-3pts CA comparable, ~1pt EPS comparable), tailwind devises desormais ~3pts sur l'EPS comparable annuel. T4 26 : 6 jours de vente en moins vs T4 25 (effet calendaire).
pointsCles: Global unit case volume +5% (strongest in ~17 years for Trademark Coca-Cola ex-COVID recovery, +5%; Powerade +8%), flattered by an easy comp, favorable weather and the record FIFA World Cup activation (>80% beverage incidence at venues across 16 host cities, >25M first-party data points, >1B Panini stickers in 40+ markets) - management itself anchors the correct read on the 2-year +2%/yr trend and a deliberately balanced volume/price-mix year.

FY26 guidance raised: organic ~5% (top of prior range), comparable currency-neutral EPS ex-M&A +7-8% (from +6-7%), all-in comparable EPS +9-10% vs $3.00 - now including ~3pts of currency TAILWIND on EPS and below-the-line benefits; modeling reminders: CCBA disposal closing late Q3/Q4 (-2/-3pts comparable revenue, ~-1pt EPS, Q4 margin uplift), concentrate ~1pt behind volume, and 6 FEWER selling days in Q4 26.

APAC is the identified 'noise' pocket: comparable operating income declined with regional price/mix -9%, decomposed by the CEO into three equal thirds (investment timing / affordability initiatives incl. cold-drink equipment / India-China geo mix) - framed as deliberate ahead-of-the-curve investment to broaden the consumer base (KO owns 7 of India's top-10 brands), with a LatAm-style payoff trajectory intended; fairlife production incident fully resolved (no Q2 impact, none material expected in H2, Webster ramp on plan, brand +18%).

IRS dispute at its final milestone: oral arguments heard by the 11th Circuit end of June, decision expected within ~6-12 months (best case: recover the $6B already deposited; worst case detailed in disclosures, ~$14B exposure) - while the balance sheet sits at 1.4x net debt/EBITDA, BELOW the 2-2.5x target, giving flexibility either way; Marriott won back after 34 years (with Monster included), Q2 comparable operating margin possibly an all-time record (+~90bp).

hypothese.text:
== THESIS SUMMARY ==
World leader in non-alcoholic beverages with an asset-light concentrate model (comparable operating margin 35.6% in Q2, FCF ~12bn/yr) behind 32 billion-dollar brands and an unreplicable bottling system. A defensive-quality holding, reinforced this quarter: guidance raised for the second consecutive time (comparable EPS +9/10% vs +8/9%), on unit volume +5% - the best quarter in ~17 years, largely FIFA World Cup activation, a powerful but NON-recurring catalyst that must not be extrapolated.

== THESIS READ ==
- The raise is real but flattered by the World Cup and ~3pts FX tailwind; underlying algorithm remains organic 4-6% / EPS high-single-digit. Watch: H2 volume ex-event.
- Portfolio pruning continues (CCBA disposal: ~1pt EPS, 2-3pts revenue headwind absorbed within the raised guidance). Watch: further refranchising.
- Balance sheet gradually deleveraging (net debt 33.3bn to ~9bn by 2030 in the model) while equity income from bottling investees grows - both feed the below-EBIT line. Watch: 11th-circuit appeal decision on the tax litigation.

== SPECIAL FACTORS ==
Base = COMPARABLE (management/consensus metric, unchanged since setup; comparable/GAAP gap dominated by punctual non-operating items). The bridge carries a large positive 'other' (+2.6-3.7bn): equity income from bottling investees below EBIT - structural to KO, documented, not a red flag. Underlying ETR 19.9% per guidance; the tax litigation is the tail risk on that line.

== PARAMETERS & WATCH-LIST ==
2026: revenue by explicit bridge (2025 x (1 + 5% organic + 1% FX - 2.5% CCBA) = 49,580); EPS anchored on the raised guidance mid (+9.5% -> 3.29). 2027-2030: organic mid-single-digit, margin drift, shares -0.2%/yr. Bridge: ETR 19.9% flat, finNet improving with deleveraging, equity income growing. Published 2025 reconciles at ~0 residual. Watch: ownership field still absent (out of refresh scope); World Cup comp in 2027.

== CATALYSTS ==
Q3 (Oct); FY26 guidance for 2027 (Feb); tax-litigation appeal decision; refranchising steps.

ancrages.moteur: Guidance FY26 relevee pour la 2e fois consecutive au T2 : comparable EPS +9-10% (vs +8-9% au T1) vs 3,00$ en 2025, organique porte a ~5% (haut de fourchette 4-5%), tailwind devises annuel desormais estime a 3 points sur l'EPS comparable.

Cession CCBA desormais quantifiee : headwind 2026 de 2-3pts sur le CA comparable et ~1pt sur l'EPS comparable, cloture attendue fin T3/T4 26 ; benefice structurel de marge attendu des le T4 (sortie d'une activite d'embouteillage a basse marge), charges de depreciation anterieures deja partiellement reprises en 2026.

Litige transfer pricing IRS desormais chiffre par la societe : exposition potentielle ~14 Md$ (impot+interets 2010-2025), 6,0 Md$ deja verses en depot de garantie, decision d'appel attendue sous 6-12 mois (plaidoiries tenues fin juin 2026). Risque idiosyncratique majeur volontairement maintenu HORS base centrale (non provisionne), a traiter comme asymetrie baissiere non chiffree dans les adjXXX plutot qu'integre.

Volume T2 +5% (meilleur trimestre depuis ~17 ans) largement tire par l'activation Coupe du Monde FIFA, evenement non recurrent ; base de comparaison plus difficile attendue au S2 2026 et en 2027, combinee a 6 jours de vente en moins au T4 26 (effet calendaire).

Perte de parts de valeur en Asie-Pacifique concentree sur l'Inde (price/mix regional -9%), assumee par le management comme investissement deliberement multi-decennal (accessibilite prix, mix geographique) plutot que perte de competitivite - watch-list plutot que retraitement chiffre a ce stade, impact potentiel modeste si la lecture du management se confirme.
